newsitem.title: UK: Reckitt up on broker 'add' recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Reckitt up on broker 'add' recommendation.

text.p: Shares in Reckitt and Colman Plc pushed ahead in early trading, boosted by a broker recommendation and amid continuing press talk of its being a target for Unilever, dealers said.
Reckitt shares were up 11 pence at 817p bid by 0758 GMT on volume of 635,000, in the process closing a gap on charts which opened over the Easter break.

NatWest Securities said it was advising clients to add to their Reckitt holdings, saying it had made a good start to the year, particularly in the U.S. and it was holding its forecasts despite the continued strength of sterling.
The Financial Times newspaper said there was speculation Unilever would use the proceeeds of the sale of its specialty chemicals division to bid for Reckitt.
